name: K-9, Mark I
clause: As long as ~ is untapped, other legendary creatures you control have ward {1}.

needs.proposedSignature: `anthem.keywordParams?: { ward?: ManaCost | AbilityCost; toxic?: number; bushido?: number; rampage?: number; protectionFrom?: string[] }` (and the same optional field on the `grant-keyword` effect and on `self-keywords`), plus an engine implementation of ward that triggers on a spell or ability AN OPPONENT CONTROLS
needs.semantics: Every parameterised keyword loses its parameter when it is GRANTED: `anthem.keywords` / `grant-keyword.keywords` are bare `Keyword`s, and `wardCost` / `toxic` / `bushido` are face-level fields describing only the card's own copy of the keyword. 'other legendary creatures you control have ward {1}' therefore cannot carry the {1}, and the round-trip gate scores it a hard 0 because the rendering never prints the number. Writing ward out as a granted triggered ability is not a substitute: the `targeted` trigger event has no 'by an opponent' form, so it would also fire on its controller's own spells. (Ward is also not simulated anywhere in src/engine today — see keyword-action.ts:420 — so the engine half is missing as well as the declaration half.)
needs.clause: As long as ~ is untapped, other legendary creatures you control have ward {1}.
